question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (AMD)

calls.reasoning: AMD guided Q3 2026 revenue ~$13.0B ±$0.3B; consensus ~$13.06-13.09B; Jefferies expects $13.5B. Over the last 8 quarters AMD beat its guidance midpoint every time, by ~1.8-7% (avg ~4%; Q2 2026: $11.536B vs $11.2B guide, +3%). Applying that distribution to $13.0B gives a median near $13.45B. Supply limits (wafers/packaging/HBM) and soft PC/gaming in H2 cap the upside; the MI450 ramp mostly lands in Q4. No Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold market found for AMD revenue. Escapes below $12B or above $14.2B judged negligible.

calls.reconciliation: All three dossiers agree on guidance ($13.0B ± $0.3B), consensus (~$13.06-13.12B), the Q2'26 beat (+3.0%) and the overlapping beat history; the pre-Q2'26 beat figures are from the runs' memory and unverified. The 8-quarter mean (~+4.2%) implies ~$13.55B as the raw base rate. The disputes are judgment: how much weight the shrinking-beat trend and the supply/PC headwinds get. No web access this run; I took a median of +3.1% (between Run 2's +2.7% and Runs 1/3's +3.5%) because the trend says the beat is smaller than the 8-quarter mean, while server strength makes a beat below the top of the guide unlikely. I carried forward Runs 1/3's beat-SD dispersion method (~$565M) and widened it slightly.
